unstated.what: A new private helper function named `_get_gdal_version` must exist in `pygmt/_show_versions.py` — the tests import it by this exact name, which the instruction never mentions (it only lists solution strategies like subprocess/ctypes).

`_get_gdal_version` must return a clean bare version string like '3.10.3', not the verbose `gdalinfo --version` output ('GDAL 3.10.3, released ...') — a formatting requirement not stated in the instruction.
unstated.quote: assert re.match(r"^\d+\.\d+", gdal_version), f"_get_gdal_version() returned non-version-like string: {gdal_version!r}"

instruction_covers: GDAL version must be detected even without GDAL Python bindings (e.g. via subprocess `gdalinfo --version` or ctypes on the C library)
